name: Comment Wrapper
author: NPad++ Community
summary: Comment out or uncomment code, add block and doc comments, using the syntax of the document's language.
documentation: Comment or uncomment the selected lines with the right marker for the document language (// for C-style languages, # for Python/Ruby/Shell/YAML, -- for SQL/Lua, ; for Lisp/INI, % for LaTeX). Block Comment wraps the selection in /* */, <!-- -->, =begin/=end and friends; Doc Comment makes a Javadoc/JSDoc block, a Python docstring or /// lines.
